description: Defines a composable UI component 'InterestsItem' for displaying interest topics with follow/unfollow functionality, including preview functions for different states.

methods.name: InterestsItem
methods.description: Composable function to display an interest item with icon, name, description, and follow toggle.

methods.name: InterestsIcon
methods.description: Private composable to display the icon for the interest, either as an image or default icon.

methods.name: InterestsCardPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for InterestsItem with default state.

methods.name: InterestsCardLongNamePreview
methods.description: Preview composable for InterestsItem with a long name.

methods.name: InterestsCardLongDescriptionPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for InterestsItem with a long description.

methods.name: InterestsCardWithEmptyDescriptionPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for InterestsItem with empty description.

methods.name: InterestsCardSelectedPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for InterestsItem in selected state.
